rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a person or thing is not good-looking.

example.english: This dress is really unattractive when worn.
example.traditional: 呢條裙着上身真係唔靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 zoek6 soeng5 san1 zan1 hai6 m4 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a person, thing, or topic that lacks appeal, including visual appeal or interest, rather than specifically saying it is ugly or boring.

example.english: This job is unattractive to me because the pay is not high.
example.traditional: 呢份工作人工唔高，對我嚟講唔吸引。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jan4 gung1 m4 gou1 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 m4 kap1 jan5

rows.note: Use this when something is unattractive because it is boring or fails to hold your interest.

example.english: I find the film unattractive because the story is so boring.
example.traditional: 呢套戲個故事好悶，我睇到瞓着。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 go3 gu3 si6 hou2 mun6 ngo5 tai2 dou3 fan3 zoek6
